constraint: owner: ONE disk, ONE partition holding Linux 7.3 (Bun OS / Arch), Wine/Proton (absorbed) and ReactOS

primary.partitionTable: MBR (msdos), one primary partition at 1 MiB; GRUB core.img lives in the 1 MiB gap before it

topLevel(FS_TREE id 5): freeldr.sys, freeldr.ini, reactos/ (ReactOS tree) plain files and directories, NOT in a subvolume
ReactOS payload directories carry `btrfs property set compression none`

subvolumes.@data: shared data, mounted in Linux at /srv/shared, exported to ReactOS over SMB

primary.why: FreeLoader reads only the top-level subvolume (BTRFS_FS_TREE_OBJECTID) and no compression (boot/freeldr/freeldr/lib/fs/btrfs.c), so ReactOS lives in the top level, Linux in @bunos.

secondary.partitionTable: GPT, one partition = the ESP (FAT32, type C12A7328-F81F-11D2-BA4B-00A0C93EC93B)
layout: bunos.img (loopback ext4/btrfs root, mounted by the initramfs)
secondary.reactos: only through FreeLoader's UEFI port (boot/freeldr/freeldr/uefi.cmake), experimental and not in the 0.4.16 release ISO: unverified

discarded.uki-efistub-no-bootloader: still needs an ESP FAT partition (UEFI spec 2.10 section 13.3: firmware loads from FAT); no way to start ReactOS, so it cannot be the multikernel path.
